name: diskann_build
doc: Single builder: PQ training and compression, partition into shards, per-shard build, merge, disk layout, sample.

overlap.doc: shards a point is put in (traced)

cache.doc: the block reader's and the layout writer's block (traced)

stream.doc: the read length of a C++ stream on a file (traced)

chunk.doc: the write length of a C++ stream (traced)

big.doc: one read or write call for a whole array; Linux transfers at most this much per call

degree.doc: [config] the graph's degree, as the disk layout reads it from the merged graph

shard_index_bytes.doc: a shard's graph (measured: about 132 bytes per point of the shard at degree 64)

index_bytes.doc: the merged graph (measured: about 205 bytes per point at degree 64)

sample_rows.doc: rows of the sample of the base written for the search's warm-up (100,131 of a million traced)

pq_train.doc: [measure] PQ training: the build's on its hosts
